title: Last Time - Miniround Version
description: A fork of my Last Time datapack for Minirounds
body:
Archived due to the functionality of this mod being added to the main mod

This adds the Last Life lives rolling into Limited Life! (made for minirounds

#
**YOU MUST HAVE THE LIFE SERIES MOD FOR THIS TO WORK!!**

---
**THIS IS FOR LIMITED LIFE**

---


By default, the amount of hours you can get are anywhere from 1-12 hours!
This Datapack assumes you are using the config I use (can be found below) the title colours will NOT change if you change the life Series Mod config. To change the colours or min/max times you will have to unzip the file and then change the .mcfunction files

The config that this datapack is used for:
(all of this found under "Season Specific Settings" of limited life)
Tick Offline Players: Yes (does not matter but good for minirounds)
Broadcast Color Chnages: Yes (does not matter but good for minirounds)
Show Time Below Name: Yes (does not matter but good for minirounds)

Time Default: 32400 (IMPORTANT)
Time Yellow: 21600 (IMPORTANT)
Time Red: 10800 (IMPORTANT)
Time Death: -3600 (Default, does not matter but good for balancing)
Time Death Boogeyman: -7200 (Default, does not matter but good for balancing)
Time Kill: 1800 (Default, does not matter but good for balancing)
Time Kill Boogeyman: 3600 (Default, does not matter but good for balancing)
